riddles.clue: I have four legs and a top, but never walk (5)
riddles.hint: Dinner is served on me.

riddles.clue: I have a seat and a back, and I am made for one person (5)
riddles.hint: Pull me up for dinner.

riddles.clue: I am a seat with no back to lean on (5)
riddles.hint: Sit on me at the kitchen counter.

riddles.clue: I am a long seat in the park that fits a few friends (5)
riddles.hint: Players wait on me during the game.

riddles.clue: I am a soft seat for the whole family in front of the TV (4)
riddles.hint: Some people call me a couch.

riddles.clue: You sleep in me every night (3)
riddles.hint: Make me every morning.

riddles.clue: I am soft and squishy, and your head rests on me at night (6)
riddles.hint: Grab me for a fluffy fight.

riddles.clue: Homework gets done on me, and my drawers hold your pens (4)
riddles.hint: I live in a study or a classroom.

riddles.clue: I hang on the wall and hold your stories up high (5)
riddles.hint: Things sit on me up high.

riddles.clue: I am a cupboard with doors, and cups and bowls hide inside me (7)
riddles.hint: Open my doors in the kitchen.

riddles.clue: Hang your coat on me, or dry the dishes on me (4)
riddles.hint: I am a frame with bars or hooks.

riddles.clue: I am made of wooden slats for moving fruit or toys (5)
riddles.hint: Pack me, stack me, then nail my lid shut.

riddles.clue: I am big, round and wooden, and I roll if you tip me over (6)
riddles.hint: Metal hoops hold my sides together.

riddles.clue: Click me on and I light up the room (4)
riddles.hint: My bulb glows when it gets dark.

riddles.clue: I spin round and round to keep you cool (3)
riddles.hint: Switch me on when it is hot.

riddles.clue: I have a face and two hands, but no arms or legs (5)
riddles.hint: Tick, tock!

riddles.clue: Look into me and you see yourself looking back (6)
riddles.hint: I hang in the bathroom.

riddles.clue: Music comes out of me, loud and clear (7)
riddles.hint: Turn me up for a dance party.

riddles.clue: Put bread in me and it pops up warm and crunchy (7)
riddles.hint: I live in the kitchen next to the kettle.

riddles.clue: I grow green leaves by a sunny window (5)
riddles.hint: Give me a drink so I do not droop.

riddles.clue: Wipe your muddy feet on me by the front door (3)
riddles.hint: Roll me out for yoga.

riddles.clue: I am flat with a long handle, and eggs sizzle in me (3)
riddles.hint: Flip! Careful, I get hot.

riddles.clue: Soup bubbles inside me on the stove (3)
riddles.hint: Flowers can grow in me too.

riddles.clue: I am round and flat, and your dinner sits on me (5)
riddles.hint: Wash me after you eat.

riddles.clue: I wear candles on top at a birthday party (4)
riddles.hint: Make a wish and blow!

riddles.clue: I have a crust on top and fruit inside, and you eat me in slices (3)
riddles.hint: Bake me in the oven until I am golden.

riddles.clue: I am a crunchy fruit, red or green (5)
riddles.hint: One a day keeps the doctor away.

riddles.clue: I am a sweet drink full of fizzy bubbles (4)
riddles.hint: Shake my can and I might spray!

riddles.clue: I fill rivers, rain clouds and your bath (5)
riddles.hint: Drink me when you are thirsty.

riddles.clue: Rub me on your hands to get them clean (4)
riddles.hint: I can be a bar or come out of a pump.

riddles.clue: I am the fluffy white bubbles on top of a wave (4)
riddles.hint: Squish me and I spring back.

riddles.clue: I have a long handle and bristles, and I sweep the floor (5)
riddles.hint: Witches ride me in stories.

riddles.clue: Bang, bang! I knock nails into wood (6)
riddles.hint: Find me in a toolbox.

riddles.clue: Kick me, throw me or bounce me (4)
riddles.hint: I am round and I roll away.

riddles.clue: Swing me to hit a home run in baseball (3)
riddles.hint: My animal twin sleeps upside down.

riddles.clue: I am a big furry animal who loves honey (4)
riddles.hint: Kids hug teddy versions of me.

riddles.clue: Light my fuse and run, because I go boom (4)
riddles.hint: Cartoon villains love to throw me.

riddles.clue: I am the sharp, flat edge of a sword or a knife (5)
riddles.hint: Ice skates have one under each foot.

riddles.clue: I am a long pole with a sharp point that hunters carry (5)
riddles.hint: Some fishers catch fish with me.

riddles.clue: I fly with feathers at my tail toward a target (5)
riddles.hint: Signs use my shape to point the way.

riddles.clue: Knights hold me up to block a hit (6)
riddles.hint: Hold me in front of you to stay safe.
